title: ERS-EO ALPSTAR PHASE A/B1 STUDY FOR A BESPOKE SAR MISSION WITH OPTIONAL ELINT (ACTIVITY 3)
description: The ALPSTAR Phase A/B1 study for a bespoke X band SAR mission, with optional ELINT capability, aims to define a technically feasible, sovereign European space segment architecture aligned with emerging user needs and the ALPSTAR federated concept. Conducted through up to two parallel industrial contracts within participating states, the study focuses on the design of a high performance SAR payload as the primary driver, including its integration on a mature platform (TRL 8-9), while assessing the feasibility, added value,and implementation impacts of incorporating an ELINT capability either as an embedded or hosted payload. The activity includes mission and system architecture definition, interface specification with the ground and federation layers, compliance with SRD and evolving MRD use cases, and evaluation of key technologies and TRL gaps. It further delivers preliminary design solutions, end to end performance considerations (including L0/L1 processing and ELINT simulation), trade offs, and a credible roadmap toward flight readiness. Outputs also encompass a comprehensive development and procurement plan, industrial organisation, launcher options, and robust ROM cost and schedule estimates for subsequent B2/C/D/E phases, ensuring decision readiness for the ALPSTAR Governance Board.

description: COPERNICUS SPACE COMPONENT - COMPETITIVE FRAME CONTRACTS -ESA Ground Segment Operations Framework Production Service This procurement targets the delivery of the Copernicus Sentinels Production Operations Service (Copernicus Production Service). The Copernicus Production Service includesthe following functionalities:-Systematic production for processing all the satellite data acquired into a set of pre-defined user level data that are made systematically and fully available to users;-On-demand production, allowing the generation of any user level data from archived lower level user data -Reprocessing, for the bulk re-generation of user level data Copernicus Production Service will be based on service providers' technical solution in line with the ESA defined interfaces, and the use of the Instrument Data Processors (IPF) provided by ESA for the generation of the user level data.The performance of the Copernicus Production Service will be managed through a Service Level Agreement and the measurement of the service performance itself through a set of Key Performance Indicators.The Copernicus Production Service will be procured through the ESA Framework Agreements procedure, as established at Article 15 of ESA Procurement Regulations (ESA/REG/001, rev. 3 which can be downloaded at the following URL: http://emits.sso.esa.int/emits/owa/emits.main). This procedure follows a two-steps procurement approach:-Step 1 - Qualification Phase: Qualification process established through an Open Competition (Frame Invitation To Tender - Frame ITT) resulting in the award of Frame Contracts between the Agency and several service providers. Step 1 bidding period will be open until December 2021 at the earliest. -Step 2 - Implementation Phase: Restricted Competitions (Request for Proposal - RFP) between the Frame Contractors qualified under Step1resulting into the award of Work Order(s) between the Agency and one or more Frame Contractors for the implementation of the Copernicus Production Service.The Copernicus Production Service procurement is funded by the Copernicus Programme and will be open exclusively to economic operators which have their registered office in an EU Member State or a State participating in the Copernicus Programme.The Frame ITT package (Cover Letter, Frame Statement of Work, Special Conditions of Tender, Draft Frame Contract) will be available on ESA tendering website (EMITS http://emits.sso.esa.int/emits/owa/emits.main). Die Errichtung dieser Heißwassererzeugungsanlagen wurde bei der Vergabestelle in einem Projekt zusammengefasst (hier als Gesamtprojekt bezeichnet), welches im Wesentlichen aus 4 (vier) Losen besteht: Los 1: Planung, Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme von 3 (drei) E-HWE à 40 MWth und Ersatz von 3 (drei) Fernwärmepumpen, inklusive dazugehörigem kompletten Anlagenbau am Standort HKW Mitte (EPC Light SGM) Los 2: Hoch- & Tiefbauleistungen zur Errichtung eines HWE-Gebäudes, Schaltanlagengebäudes und Trafogebäudes am Standort HKW Mitte (Baulos SGM) <-- NICHT Bestandteil dieser Bekanntmachung Los 3: Zwei (2) 125 MVA 110 kV / 22 kV Transformatoren für das HKW Mitte (PTSGM) <-- NICHT Bestandteil dieser Bekanntmachung Los 4: Zwei (2) 110 kV GIS-Anlagen mit Einfachsammelschiene, bestehend jeweils aus Einspeisefeld und zwei Abgangsfeldern, inklusive Schutz- und Steuertechnik, für das HKW Mitte (GISSGM) <-- NICHT Bestandteil dieser Bekanntmachung Bestandteil dieses Beschaffungsvorhabens ist das Los 1. Die Kessel sind mittels Primär- und Sekundärkreislauf über Wärmetauscher hydraulisch in das bestehende Fernwärmenetz einzubinden. Neben den Kesseln umfasst der Leistungsumfang sämtliche Hilfssysteme Druckhaltung, Entleerung, Regelung, Rohrleitungen und Schutzfunktionen sowie die Integration in die bestehende Netzleit- und Schutztechnik der BEW. Die Regelung der Anlage erfolgt automatisiert mit hoher Dynamik zur Gewährleistung eines last- und temperaturgeführten Betriebs.
